current_state.text: Proposals are submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF.
Signed records are held in the current tool.

target_state.text: Electronic signature of forms and decisions is provided through a partner e-signature product.
Historic records and documents are migrated with trial runs, reconciliation reports and a final cut-over.

workstreams.name: Partner e-Signature Integration
workstreams.objective: Deploy partner e-signature capabilities and integrate with student records.

workstreams.name: Migration and Alternative Delivery
workstreams.objective: Migrate historic records and establish alternative service tracking and submission mechanisms.

wbs.name: Migration and Alternative Delivery
wbs.deliverable: Migrated records and alternative service processes

work_packages.name: Signature platform setup
work_packages.deliverable: Configured partner e-signature product with templates, reminders, and audit logging
work_packages.scope: Configure partner e-signature product with templates, reminders, and audit logging.
work_packages.acceptance: The partner e-signature product is configured with templates and audit logging.

effort.basis_text: Similar partner integrations took this range.

work_packages.name: API and Deployment
work_packages.deliverable: REST API integration and on-premises deployment option
work_packages.scope: Build the REST API integration and set up the on-premises deployment option.
work_packages.exclusions: Template creation and audit logging configuration.
work_packages.acceptance: The REST API is operational and on-premises deployment is verified.

work_packages.name: Historic records migration
work_packages.deliverable: Migrated signed records from the current tool
work_packages.scope: Migrate signed records from the current tool with trial runs and reconciliation.
work_packages.acceptance: Reconciliation reports confirm successful migration of historic records.

effort.basis_text: Estimated by data migration manager based on volume.
effort.uncertainty: Data quality in the current tool.

work_packages.name: Alternative bidder instructions and service levels
work_packages.deliverable: Alternative mechanisms for proposal submission and service tracking
work_packages.scope: Establish alternative mechanisms for proposal submission and service tracking.
work_packages.acceptance: Alternative bidder instructions and service levels are documented and operational.

effort.basis_text: Sum of documentation and process setup tasks.

assumptions.text: The buyer will accept alternative mechanisms for service level tracking and bidder instructions.
The timeline requirement for the service to be live by 2027-01-11 is excluded from the initial scope.

ground_rules.text: Proposals must be submitted through the portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.

tech_claims.text: Electronic signature of forms and decisions is provided through a partner e-signature product.

benefits.hypothesis: Partner e-signature speeds up form completion times.
benefits.measure: Time to complete forms before and after.

benefits.hypothesis: Alternative mechanisms improve proposal submission flexibility.
benefits.measure: Percentage of alternative submissions processed successfully.

win_themes.feature: Electronic signature of forms and decisions
win_themes.benefit: Faster decision making and automated audit trails

win_themes.feature: Historic records migration with trial runs
win_themes.metric: Zero data loss during final cut-over
